summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), extracts and chmods the binary, then execFileSync's it against a bundled 727KB sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line, heavily obfuscated blob with obfuscator.io fingerprints (rotated string-array via a push/shift rotator, mixed numeric/hex literal arrays, hex-mangled identifiers, `with` blocks) and a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header indicating it is designed to run only under Bun. The loader setup.mjs itself uses the same obfuscator.io-style identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`). No native source is shipped that would justify a second runtime, math_init.js is not referenced from the library's declared main entry (dist/cjs/index.js), and its name is unrelated to the package's stated SDK purpose. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: attacker-controlled obfuscated bytes are executed at install time under a freshly downloaded alien runtime that Node-based tooling and scanners do not observe.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
